pages.text: “A faint glow in the darkness, guiding the way forward.”$(br2)Glow Berries Tea is a mild yet mystical beverage made from dried glow berries, blended with milk for a smooth taste. Drinking it grants travelers Night Vision, making dark journeys clearer and more visible.

$(br2)$(br)To prepare Glow Berries Tea, $(br)mix two portions of dried glow berries with milk.$(br)It is ideal for nighttime exploration or deep cave adventures, allowing travelers to move without fear of darkness.

Upon drinking Glow Berries Tea, travelers gain Night Vision, making dark environments appear clear and visible.$(br)This tea is perfect for night adventures, ensuring clear visibility in the shadows.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
